title: Version 1.12.0
body:
Version 1.12.0

June 27th, 2023

New Content:

  • Added fireflies
  • Added jar to the Oak Depot
  • You can collect fireflies with a jar, and then resell them at the junkyard!
  • Added Duogon to the credits (whoops)

Changes:

  • Rocks with ores now show the ore name rather than the rock name
  • Industrial sander can now sand larger volumes
  • Removed collision for the tape on boxes

Bug Fixes:

  • Paintings are now visible through glass
  • St. Patricks Hats now anchor correctly
